nodes.author: Oail_raw
nodes.text:
🦠 What is HMPV?
HMPV is a respiratory virus first discovered in 2001. It causes cold-like symptoms such as cough, fever, and congestion. It’s been circulating globally for over 20 years. (Part 2/7)

nodes.author: Oail_raw
nodes.text:
❓ Is HMPV as dangerous as COVID-19?
NO! Unlike COVID-19, HMPV is not a new virus. It spreads slower and causes less severe illness. Most cases are mild and resolve on their own. (Part 3/7)

nodes.author: Oail_raw
nodes.text:
📊 Fatality Rate Comparison:

HMPV: Less than 2%, mainly in infants, elderly, or those with weak immunity.

COVID-19: 2-3% globally during the pandemic, causing severe complications in healthy adults. 
(Part 4/7)

nodes.author: Oail_raw
nodes.text:
🛡 Prevention Measures:
The same steps you took to avoid COVID-19 work for HMPV too:
✅ Wash hands
✅ Wear masks in crowded places
✅ Avoid contact with sick people
(Part 5/7)

nodes.author: Oail_raw
nodes.text:
⚠️ No Pandemic Risk:

Unlike COVID-19, HMPV is seasonal and manageable. It doesn’t spread rapidly or cause a healthcare crisis. India’s healthcare system is better prepared to handle such cases now. (Part 6/7)

nodes.author: Oail_raw
nodes.text:
💡 Final Word:

HMPV is not the next COVID-19. It’s a manageable virus that has existed for decades. Stay calm, stay informed, and trust facts, not fear! 🛑 Don't spread panic.
